What Is a Ductless Mini-Split System?

settings.editor:
A ductless mini-split is a heating and cooling system that operates without traditional air ducts. It includes:

  • An outdoor condenser unit
  • One or more indoor air-handling units
  • Independent temperature controls per zone

These systems provide both cooling in the summer and heating in the winter — making them a versatile, year-round solution.
